notes.title: Major Update
notes.notes:
Hi folks!

In today's major update, our game has changed in many ways. One of our most prominent features is now a new map that will welcome you every time you enter the game. As promised, our game now supports multiplayer. In Multiplayer mode, you can invite your friends or you can have a pleasant ( I hope ! ) time by joining random lobbies. We're really sorry for the time that has passed, and Rage Quit has been reworked in many ways and these have been really time-consuming work. We'll spend the next few days fixing minor problems with the game. 

Kind regards!
Developer Geo

notes.title: Major Update
notes.notes:
Today's patch unveils twitch integration with bug fixes and improvements. Twitch integration is now fully available. A button called Play With Twitch will welcome you in the main menu. All you have to do is; After entering the game world you will need to follow the instructions. From now on, your audience will be able to join and manipulate the game with you. In short, the game will start poll questions at random times and ask the audience some questions. Viewers can participate in the poll by typing "Yes" or "No" .There are several mechanics added to the Play With Twitch game mode. We will add more in new updates over time. We will also combine the multiplayer mode with twitch integration. Multiple twitch streamers can play against each other's viewers!

The multiplayer mode of the game is almost ready, but we need to test it before we have any problems. You will be able to click the multiplayer game mode button, but it will not be available to players yet. We'll release a new update about it as soon as it's ready and you'll be able to play in multiplayer mode.

There are some improvements , bug fixes and news described below.
- Collision on stairs has been fixed. Now you do not stuck at specific points that you were stucking
- Axe Trap rotation and pivot point has been fixed . 
- Cannons has been improved and now it deals damage to players aswell. 
- Inside the castle , Spiked Ball Trap had an issue with rotation . It has been fixed. 
- At main menu , when you move at the Option Tabs , texts were shifting. Now it's fully responsive.
- Leaderboard fetching has been improved. If you want your flag to appear on the leaderboard , make sure that at your Steam Profile -> Privacy Settings -> Game Details must be public.
- VOIP system has been added in to the game for multiplayer mode.
- Multiplayer support has been added to the game, but it needs some improvements, so it's not publicly available for players yet. We will also add some weapons to the game for multiplayer mode. So in this mode you can try to kill other players and grief them.
- The elapsed timer has been moved to the UI.
- The 1st Place achievement award was given to everyone who took a place at the leaderboard due to a bug. It has been fixed. Probably this achievement can be deleted from all players to avoid injustice
- When you finish the game , there was a bug at UI such as Leaderboard were overflowing out of the UI. It has been fixed. 
- At Castle entrance , moving Stone Spike Trap sometimes we're sticking and not moving until map gets restarted. Now it has been fixed and fully working
- At Options Menu , Sensivity setting were not working . Now it does work and you can change the value by your needs
- In the in-game menu, the texts in the settings section were also slipping. Now it has been fixed. 
- Sprinting is now 360 degrees and it has been improved. 
- Jump system improved but animations will be taken care off at next update. 
- Check points now have no cooldown

Kind Regards ! 
Dev Geo
